name: joplin
description: Search, read and write your Joplin notes via Joplin desktop or a (self-hosted) Joplin Server.
long_description:
Connects Claude to [Joplin](https://joplinapp.org) notes.

- **Local mode** (default): talks to Joplin desktop on this computer through its Data API. Enable *Tools > Options > Web Clipper* in Joplin. The token is auto-detected; paste it below only if detection fails.
- **Server mode**: fill in the Joplin Server URL, email and password (official or self-hosted server). Read-only unless *Allow writes* is on. End-to-end encrypted accounts must use local mode.

local_url.title: Joplin desktop API URL (local mode)
local_url.description: Leave empty for the default http://127.0.0.1:41184.

local_token.title: Joplin desktop API token (local mode)
local_token.description: Optional: auto-detected from Joplin's settings. Found under Tools > Options > Web Clipper.

server_url.title: Joplin Server URL (server mode)
server_url.description: e.g. https://joplin.example.com. Setting this switches to server mode; leave empty to use Joplin desktop.

server_password.title: Joplin Server password
server_password.description: Account password for Joplin Server. Stored in the OS keychain.

server_allow_write.title: Allow writes to Joplin Server
server_allow_write.description: Let Claude create, edit and trash notes on Joplin Server (applied by Joplin apps on next sync).

tools.name: list_notes
tools.description: List recent notes, optionally in one notebook

tools.name: get_note
tools.description: Read a note's Markdown body, tags and metadata

tools.name: update_note
tools.description: Replace, append to or move a note

tools.name: delete_note
tools.description: Move a note to the trash

tools.name: request_local_token
tools.description: Request an API token from Joplin desktop
